WebXR Input Profiles assets (controller and hand models), copied from
@webxr-input-profiles/assets 1.0 (https://github.com/immersive-web/webxr-input-profiles),
MIT licence, so the app never fetches them from cdn.jsdelivr.net (#215).
Kept: meta-quest-touch-plus (Quest 3 / 3S), meta-quest-touch-pro, oculus-touch-v3 (Quest 2), generic-hand.
profilesList.json is trimmed to these four.
